notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific source is a one-line record on the Central US Lookouts page: agency, location, removed. No build date, height, design, staffing or fire history was found. Two web searches, the Wikipedia article on Falcon (which does not mention a tower) and the MDC fire tower history page returned nothing about this tower. The Falcon name may or may not tie to the village; no source says. The story is short because the evidence is short. It would need the Missouri Lookout Towers Inventory (ebandflo.org, which did not resolve) or the Frakes book A Place Above the Trees to fill in build and fate. Removal date unknown.
